lead_in: Any one of these reasons works:
question_text: It is important for all men age 18 through 25 to register for the Selective Service. Name one reason why.

official_answers.text: Makes the draft fair, if needed

why_it_matters.text: Selective Service registration is a list of young men who could be called up if the U.S. ever needed a military draft. It's required by law for men 18-25, and the list makes sure that if a draft were ever needed, the burden would fall fairly across the population.

fun_fact.text: The U.S. hasn't actually used the draft since 1973 — over 50 years ago. The military today is all-volunteer. But every young man still has to register with Selective Service at 18, just in case.
